text:
Predicates:
BeginWith34(x) ::: x's license plate begins with the number 34.
FromIstanbul(x) ::: x's license plate is from Istanbul.
BeginWith35(x) ::: x's license plate begins with the number 35.
Premises:
∀x (FromIstanbul(x) → BeginWith34(x)) ::: All vehicle registration plates in Istanbul begin with the number 34.
∀x (¬BeginWith34(x) → ¬FromIstanbul(x)) ::: Plates that do not begin with the number 34 are not from Istanbul.
FromIstanbul(joe) ::: Joe's vehicle registration plate is from Istanbul.
BeginWith35(tom) ::: Tom's license plate begins with the number 35.
∀x (BeginWith35(x) → ¬BeginWith34(x)) ::: If a license plate begins with the number 35, then it does not begin with the number 34.
Conclusion:
FromIstanbul(tom) ::: Tom's license plate is from Istanbul.
